mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.is_used_app = 0 THEN pt.missed_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS appUnusedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.is_used_app = 1 THEN pt.missed_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cardMismatchAmount FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN user_card uc ON pt.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(pt.paid_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND pt.better_user_card_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, pt.paid_at AS approvedAt, br.brand_name AS storeName, usedCard.card_name AS usedCardName, pt.amount AS paidAmount, altCard.card_name AS alternativeCardName, ROUND(pt.alternative_discount_amount / pt.amount * 100, 0) AS discountRate, pt.missed_amount AS diffAmount FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN user_card uc ON pt.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id JOIN card_product usedCard ON uc.card_product_id = usedCard.card_product_id JOIN user_card altUc ON pt.better_user_card_id = altUc.user_card_id JOIN card_product altCard ON altUc.card_product_id = altCard.card_product_id JOIN store s ON pt.store_id = s.store_id JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN brand br ON s.brand_id = br.brand_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(pt.paid_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND pt.is_used_app = #{isUsedApp} AND pt.better_user_card_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.category_id, pt.paid_at DESC
